question_preview: What are the specific acceptance conditions and payer allocation rules for company-addressed hotel folios?

workflow_preview.title: Accommodation Reimbursement Precheck
workflow_preview.goal: Check hotel expense claims against the supplied policy and evidence. Identify what can proceed to a person for business approval, what needs clarification and what must stay on hold. Never approve or pay expenses.

input_fields.description: The name of the employee who submitted the expense claim.
input_fields.label: Claimant Name

input_fields.description: The name of the hotel guest as shown on the receipt.
input_fields.label: Guest Name

input_fields.description: The start date of the stay approved on the claim form.
input_fields.label: Approved Claim Start Date

input_fields.description: The start date of the stay as shown on the hotel receipt.
input_fields.label: Actual Stay Start Date

input_fields.description: The end date of the stay approved on the claim form.
input_fields.label: Approved Claim End Date

input_fields.description: The end date of the stay as shown on the hotel receipt.
input_fields.label: Actual Stay End Date

input_fields.description: The reimbursement amount claimed by the employee.
input_fields.label: Claimed Amount

input_fields.description: The stated employee-paid amount marked PAID on the receipt.
input_fields.label: Employee Paid Amount

input_fields.description: Whether the receipt is an accepted document under company guidelines.
input_fields.label: Is Receipt Accepted

input_fields.description: Whether the receipt contains an identified payment marked PAID.
input_fields.label: Has Paid Status

state_fields.description: The current status of the hotel precheck review process.
state_fields.label: Review Status

actions.description: The documentary precheck is complete and is ready for business approval.
actions.label: Ready for Business Approval

actions.description: Return the claim to the employee for correct name or amount details.
actions.label: Return for Correction

actions.description: Place a hold on the review due to date mismatches, unaccepted receipts, or missing evidence.
actions.label: Hold

source_refs.quote: If either hotel stay date differs, hold for a manager's decision on the changed stay; matching amounts do not resolve this exception.

rules.statement: If either hotel stay date differs, hold for a manager's decision on the changed stay.

source_refs.quote: The hotel guest must match the claimant. A known guest-name mismatch is returned for correction.

rules.statement: The hotel guest must match the claimant. A known guest-name mismatch is returned for correction.

source_refs.quote: For an accepted receipt with an identified employee payment marked PAID, a known amount mismatch is returned for correction.

rules.statement: For an accepted receipt with an identified employee payment marked PAID, a known amount mismatch is returned for correction.

source_refs.quote: The acceptance conditions for a company-addressed hotel folio are not recorded here, including how to use its payer allocation.

rules.statement: If the hotel receipt is not accepted under policy (e.g. company-addressed folios), hold the case.

source_refs.quote: If a required value, payer allocation or payment status is missing, hold and request the specific missing evidence.

rules.statement: If required paid status is missing, hold the review.

source_refs.quote: Mark the documentary precheck complete only when claimant and guest match, both stay dates match the approved dates, the receipt is accepted, and the claimed amount equals the stated employee-paid amount marked PAID.

rules.statement: Mark precheck complete when claimant matches guest, stay dates match, receipt is accepted, and claim amount equals paid amount.

evidence_origin: Owner-provided Cloud Shell output; not an independent cloud read.

findings.issue: A policy acceptance decision is requested as an input fact. The receipt addressee needed to derive that decision is not declared.
The description identifies any PAID payment, without preserving whether the employee payment is PAID. It can mix another payer with the employee.
An unspecified acceptance criterion is represented as a false acceptance input. Unknown permission must remain unresolved; apply explicit source conditions and default hold.
